about: Held-head jitter measured from dev/enrol-record.py's `still` recording (10 s, head held, 2026-11-02): the spread of the five-point pose indices across its lit one-face frames. Statistics only; the frames and landmarks are not committed.
note: a held head drifts slowly (lag-1 autocorrelation 0.91 on u), it is not white noise: the replay of this recording is steady in 98% of frames at 3.1.3's constants and in 4% at 3.1.2's
